account: It is day 0, about 09:00. I came from home to town hall and read the appointment book. Today's schedule is morning correspondence, a 10:00 market walk in the plaza, lunch at home at noon, town accounts at 13:00, tea with the neighbour at a dockside cottage on the east bank at 15:00, office at 16:30, and home at 19:00. Tomorrow includes a grain inspection at the mill at 10:00. The secretary is beside me holding a writable book. I asked about correspondence and news but have not heard a reply. Several townsfolk have passed or gathered near the plaza side of town hall; I have not heard them say anything or seen anything that establishes unusual activity. Although I have a feeling something may be happening without my knowledge, I currently have no evidence of what it is, who might be involved, or its purpose. My market walk is an opportunity to listen and ask about town business without assuming there is a secret.
